import time
def run(n):
    t0 = app.actions.run('timeline.status')['tick']
    app.actions.run('sim.step', steps=n)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60.0
    while app.actions.run('timeline.status')['tick'] < t0 + n:
        assert time.monotonic() < deadline
        app.update(True)
    for _ in range(8):
        app.update(True)
def joints(key):
    return {j['name']: j[key] for j in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']}
reach = ${reach}['joints']
a = app.actions.run('robot.pose_apply', name='reach', duration=0.2)
assert a['set'] == 3 and a['missing'] == [] and a['unknown'] == [] and a['steps'] > 4, a
n = a['steps']
k = n // 2
run(k)
t = joints('target')
assert all(abs(t[j] - k / n * reach[j]) < 1e-4 for j in reach), (t, k, n)
run(n - k + 200)
t, q = joints('target'), joints('q')
assert all(abs(t[j] - reach[j]) < 1e-6 for j in reach), t
assert all(abs(q[j] - reach[j]) < 0.05 for j in reach), q

import time, numpy as np, nuka
root = lambda: np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE), dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 7)[0, :3].copy()
a = root()
app.actions.run('sim.step', steps=60)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 60.0
while app.actions.run('timeline.status')['tick'] < 60:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline
    app.update(True)
b = root()
assert np.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-5) and a[2] > 0.5, (a, b)
